nameOrigin: intermediary between the natural and supernatural worlds

pokedexEntries.di: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

pokedexEntries.prl: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

pokedexEntries.pt: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

pokedexEntries.hgss: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

pokedexEntries.bd: It lives in common flower patches but is rarely noticed. It is often mistaken for a flowering plant when curled up.

pokedexEntries.la: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.
